gloss: in the middle of; right in the midst of; during

definitions.gloss: in the middle of; right in the midst of; during
definitions.explanation: Indicates being right in the middle of an action or situation, often when something unexpected happens or interrupts. Stronger than just 'during' — it emphasizes the exact moment within an ongoing activity.

examples.japanese: {食事|しょくじ}の{最中|さいちゅう}に{電話|でんわ}が{鳴|な}った。
examples.english: The phone rang in the middle of my meal.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}の{最中|さいちゅう}に{地震|じしん}が{起|お}きた。
examples.english: An earthquake occurred in the middle of the meeting.

examples.japanese: {試験勉強|しけんべんきょう}の{最中|さいちゅう}に{友達|ともだち}が{遊|あそ}びに{来|き}て{困|こま}った。
examples.english: A friend came to hang out right when I was studying for exams, which was a problem.

notes:
Composed of {最中|さいちゅう} (in the midst of) and the particle に. Often used when an interruption or unexpected event occurs during an ongoing activity.

GRAMMAR:
Attaches to nouns or verb dictionary form + の:
- {食事|しょくじ}の{最中|さいちゅう}に: in the middle of eating
- {話|はな}している{最中|さいちゅう}に: in the middle of talking
- {寝|ね}ている{最中|さいちゅう}に: while sleeping

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- ～{中|ちゅう}に: during — more neutral, less emphasis on 'right in the middle'
- ～ている{途中|とちゅう}で: halfway through — emphasis on the midpoint of a process
- ～{最中|さいちゅう}だ: to be in the middle of (predicative) — {今|いま}まさに{作業|さぎょう}の{最中|さいちゅう}だ (I'm right in the middle of work)

CAUTION:
Do not confuse {最中|さいちゅう} (in the middle of) with {最中|もなか} (a traditional Japanese wafer cake filled with bean paste). Same kanji, different readings and meanings.
